Body.Content: Azure Service Fabric helps developers build, deploy, and operate microservice architecture applications reliably and at scale. By using its actor-based development approach, teams are able to scale their agile development practices to bring new capabilities to market faster than before. Applications will run across a range of cloud and on-premises environments. The Service Fabric public preview is available as an SDK for local development and as an Azure service. This public preview is available at no additional cost. For more information, please visit the Azure Service Fabric page.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Service Fabric helps developers build, deploy, and operate microservice architecture applications reliably and at scale. By using its actor-based development approach, teams are able to scale their agile development practices to bring new capabilities to market faster than before. Applications will run across a range of cloud and on-premises environments.

The Service Fabric public preview is available as an SDK for local development and as an Azure service. This public preview is available at no additional cost. For more information, please visit the Azure Service Fabric page.
